pilot_gate_policy: P0 must pass independent rerun, event trace, Lead review and A8 review before production batch acceptance.

parallelism.rule: Each batch owns separate files and has a named independent reviewer. B8 integration is last. Do not advance to the next wave while required findings remain open.

cross_batch_coverage.variants: All 60 variant IDs and 167 case IDs map to a fixture using an explicit variant-to-entry-point binding or an approved disposition.
cross_batch_coverage.solutions: All 719 solution obligation IDs (74 normal, 143 boundary, 108 counterexample, 394 source-fixture links across 368 unique source parts) map to passing evidence or an approved disposition.
cross_batch_coverage.worked_examples: All 58 specs, 210 microcase IDs and 261 evidence-capture IDs map to fixture/run evidence or an approved disposition.
cross_batch_coverage.errors: All 154 error rows expand to 308 phase obligations; each detection and repair phase maps to assertion evidence or a Lead-approved disposition.
cross_batch_coverage.source_caveats: All 25 issue IDs and 62 occurrence IDs are ingested exactly once in SOURCE_OCCURRENCE_OWNERSHIP.json, with one primary owner and any secondary consumers. Each occurrence is classified as executable, documentary/facsimile, or adjudication evidence; issue completion is the union of occurrence coverage.
cross_batch_coverage.visuals: All 58 Stage 4 preliminary visual briefs, 174 normal/boundary/failure scenarios and 331 proposed event-entry IDs map to verified run-based trace bundles. Each brief maps to one or more fixture traces; actual trace-run count is reported and is not fixed at 58.
cross_batch_coverage.marking: All 2236 Stage 4 marking atom IDs retain canonical owner/method joins and map to evidence or an approved disposition without synthetic mark values.

support_policy: Graph coding, low-level programming and declarative programming remain excluded. Support concepts are verified only through linked pattern tests or labelled non-code fixture/disposition.
ownership_policy: At S5-0 generate a frozen obligation inventory and source-occurrence ownership registry. For each occurrence choose the earliest matching batch in canonical order from pattern_ids, else context_pattern_ids; if neither maps to a Stage 5 pattern, assign A3/SOURCE_REGISTER and require documentary/facsimile or adjudication evidence. Other matching batches are secondary consumers.
